long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The telescope is mine and the morning sky should be checked on it before anyone else looks.
Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, so I will read until I have an answer.
Clay is good and I mean to have a finished piece of it in my collection.
One piece of clay becomes a finished small object, and I will keep it where I can see it.
Energy is wearing thin and a patch of sun is the right place to recover.
Dusk is coming, and the lookout rock is mine to be above things on.

today.reason: I will settle my claims, learn about seeds, make one clay object and rest in the sun before dusk.
